# Isolde Pembroke

## Overview

- **Age:** 11 at the start of volume 1, turning 13 near the end of volume 1  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c26 P4](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040)</sub>
- **Origin:** Pear Hill, Brierley  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Isolde is an extremely attractive, plumper girl with dark, shiny hair and dark black eyes inherited from her mother. She has rosy, red cheeks and a cheerful expression inherited as a legacy from her father.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039)_

## Personality

Isolde is good, intelligent, cheerful, and ladylike. She loves reading books and enjoys poetry, romantic naming, and making handicrafts. Although she is well-mannered, she occasionally participates in playful pranks and adventures with her best friend Nell.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P22](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0022), [v1 c19 P34](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0034), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)_

## History

After returning from a visit to her aunt in Delford, Isolde became fast friends and sworn bosom companions with Nell Harcourt, creating a playhouse called Larkrise and sharing books and adventures. When Nell unintentionally served her potent homemade cordial, Isolde became intoxicated and sick, leading her strict mother to briefly forbid their friendship until Nell redeemed herself by saving Posy Fay. During a concert trip and sleepover, Isolde and Nell accidentally jumped onto her visiting Great-Aunt Lavinia Pembroke in bed, leading Nell to confess and secure Lavinia's forgiveness and music lessons for Isolde. Later, Isolde attended a town trip to Beechwood in Port Marlow with Nell, where they visited an exhibition, listened to a famous prima donna, and enjoyed ice cream. She became an active member of the local Improvement Society and continued her close bond with Nell into her teenage years, eventually falling in love with Gideon Duckett.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c16 P42](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0042), [v1 c16 P49](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0049), [v1 c16 P59](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0059), [v1 c18 P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043), [v1 c19 P52](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0052), [v1 c19 P54](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0054), [v1 c19 P81](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0081), [v1 c19 P83](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0083), [v1 c19 P91](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0091), [v1 c29 P17](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0017), [v1 c29 P23](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0023), [v1 c29 P25](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0025), [v1 c29 P26](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0026), [v2 c2 P0](../source/v02-c02.md#nw-v02-c02-p0000), [v2 c29 P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011)_
